approach: Static recompilation of the PPU and SPU code to C++, a reimplementation of the PS3 system libraries, a Vulkan RSX backend
help: Testing on other GPUs (AMD, Intel) and CPUs
Playing long sessions to catch the known server crash
Confirming audio output on a machine with a sound device
notes: Needs your own copy of the game (a decrypted EBOOT from your own BLES01976 disc, and the firmware modules from your own PS3 dump); the build happens on your PC. Playable: world creation proven 10/10, movement, mining, inventory and block placement in Survival. 99.9% of SPU code compiled ahead of time, measured during world generation.
